description: The CAREGIVERS table contains information about caregivers, including their unique identifier (CGID), abbreviated job title (LABEL), and full job title (DESCRIPTION). Each row is uniquely identified by ROW_ID. This table provides a mapping between caregiver identifiers and their corresponding roles.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the dataset.

columns.name: LABEL
columns.description: Abbreviated job title or role of a caregiver (e.g., RN, CNA).

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Full job title or role of a caregiver, corresponding to the abbreviated LABEL (e.g., Registered Nurse).
